config.yaml: Blank the upstream shared weather API key because it is unsafe for redistribution in this repository.
buddy-neutral-prompt.txt: Provide a neutral native prompt template so Buddy Core remains the sole persona and prompt owner.
core/buddy/__init__.py: Add the minimal Buddy integration package required to keep Task 4 provider failures separate from valid silence.
core/buddy/provider_errors.py: Define typed public ASR provider failures so upstream ASR errors are not converted to empty recognition.
core/buddy/config_contract.py: Validate the Buddy production ownership contract after configuration merge, including the actual context-provider, voiceprint, and neutral-prompt runtime keys, and reject local remote-manager settings before any remote fetch.
core/buddy/diagnostics.py: Provide a bounded, redacted in-process lifecycle registry for XiaoZhi's existing SimpleHttpServer debug endpoints without IPC or speech queues.
core/buddy/session_context.py: Provide the immutable, lock-protected per-connection identity registry used by the Buddy Core LLM provider.
core/connection.py: Register and remove immutable Buddy session identity, preserve invocation-local dialogue snapshots, and bypass upstream tools and manager title persistence in Buddy mode.
core/handle/abortHandle.py: Record a best-effort bounded abort event after the native abort path completes without taking ownership of speech cleanup.
core/handle/sendAudioHandle.py: Record best-effort TTS lifecycle events after the existing native send path has emitted its control message.
core/handle/textHandler/listenMessageHan: Record best-effort listen lifecycle events at the owning text handler without reparsing frames or changing turn decisions.
core/handle/helloHandle.py: Prevent device-advertised MCP initialization in Buddy mode while retaining the upstream path outside Buddy mode.
core/providers/llm/buddy_core/__init__.p: Add the Buddy Core LLM provider package to the native XiaoZhi provider layout.
core/providers/llm/buddy_core/buddy_core: Route a current user turn with immutable connection metadata to the local Buddy Core OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
core/providers/asr/buddy_qwen.py: Add the compatibility-authorized Qwen chat-completions ASR provider for the configured endpoint after native DashScope returned HTTP 404.
core/providers/asr/buddy_fault.py: Provide a loopback-only deterministic ASR provider used exclusively by the gated fault-recovery test runtime.
core/providers/asr/base.py: Preserve typed ASR provider failures through the native voice-stop boundary, guard stale callbacks by invocation generation, and otherwise retain native ASR lifecycle ownership.
core/providers/asr/qwen3_asr_flash.py: Preserve native Qwen provider failures as typed outcomes and pass configured endpoint and timeout to the DashScope SDK compatibility gate.
core/providers/tts/buddy_qwen_http.py: Add the configured Qwen HTTP TTS provider through the native flat loader while leaving upstream audio queueing, encoding, playback, and abort handling unchanged.
core/providers/tts/base.py: Notify the connection lifecycle hook only after final native TTS retry exhaustion or the existing worker catch, without duplicating queue or playback control.
core/http_server.py: Expose bounded local diagnostics through the existing SimpleHttpServer alongside the native OTA routes without creating another HTTP process.
app.py: Revalidate the effective Buddy ownership contract before constructing either XiaoZhi listener.
config/config_loader.py: Validate Buddy local and merged configuration before remote selection, directory setup, or cache reuse.
